I found 6 Y Combinator startups from the 2022 and 2023 batches that are based in France and currently have job openings. I got them by filtering the YC startup directory for the Winter 2022, Summer 2022, Winter 2023 and Summer 2023 batches, HQ region France, and "Is Hiring".

| Company | Batch | Location | What they do |
|---|---|---|---|
| Osium AI | Summer 2023 | Paris | Speeds up materials innovation with AI |
| Rimward | Summer 2023 | Paris | Solar farm security software for existing cameras |
| Twenty | Summer 2023 | Paris | Open-source CRM |
| HyLight | Summer 2023 | Paris | Unmanned airships for inspecting critical assets |
| Escape | Winter 2023 | Paris | Offensive security for teams that are heavily outnumbered |
| Windmill | Summer 2022 | Paris | Open-source platform that turns scripts into internal apps and workflows |

The directory's own note says this list doesn't include companies originally founded in France, or by French founders, that are headquartered elsewhere. I didn't open the individual job listings, so I can't tell you the specific roles.
